title: Release simplegraph 1.0.1
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [x] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_simplegraph.html)
* [x] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [x] ~~`usethis::use_github_links()`~~
* [x] `devtools::build_readme()`
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [x] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [x] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [x] `revdepcheck::revdep_check(num_workers = 4)`
* [x] ~~Update `cran-comments.md`~~
* [x] `git push`

Submit to CRAN:

* [x] `usethis::use_version('patch')`
* [x] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [x] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [x] Accepted :tada:
* [x] Create GH release
* [x] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
